title: Delivery: Event
description: The "delivery" type lets you attribute metrics to messages that don't self-report back to Customer.io, like push and in-app notifications.

type.description: The "delivery" type lets you attribute metrics to messages that don't self-report back to Customer.io, like push and in-app notifications.

action.description: An `event` action indicates a delivery event. Use the `name` to determine the specific metric that you want to attribute to this delivery.

identifiers.description: Contains identifiers for the delivery itself.

id.description: The `delivery_id` for the delivery that you want to attribute metrics to.

name.description: The name of the metric you want to attribute to this "delivery".

attributes.description: Contains information about the delivery and the individual who received the message.

device_token.description: The device that received the message.
